text: One team played to their potential and one didn't. Loss, yes - humiliation, no. It was a defeat we deserved, we just weren't good enough.

context.en: Real Madrid, after a 5-0 defeat at Barcelona
context.es: Real Madrid, tras perder 5-0 en el campo del Barcelona
context.pt: Real Madrid, depois de perder 5-0 no campo do Barcelona

text: Normally, a coach is loved after victories. In this case I feel that I am loved before victories.

context.en: Fenerbahçe, speaking to the fans at his unveiling
context.es: Fenerbahçe, ante la afición en su presentación
context.pt: Fenerbahçe, aos adeptos na apresentação

text: For me, it is the most important trophy of my career because it is the last. That's the way I look at things.

context.en: Manchester United, after winning the Europa League final
context.es: Manchester United, tras ganar la final de la Europa League
context.pt: Manchester United, depois de ganhar a final da Liga Europa

text: The signal of close your mouth was not for them but for the press. They speak too much and in my opinion they try to do everything to disturb Chelsea. Wait, don't speak too soon.

context.en: Chelsea, explaining his gesture during the League Cup final win over Liverpool
context.es: Chelsea, explicando su gesto en la final de la Copa de la Liga ganada al Liverpool
context.pt: Chelsea, a explicar o gesto na final da Taça da Liga ganha ao Liverpool

text: I don't have another way to thank them than by giving everything I have, which I have always, which I will do always. It's the only way to thank them for this reaction.

context.en: Chelsea, thanking the fans who sang his name during a difficult run
context.es: Chelsea, agradeciendo a la afición que coreó su nombre en una mala racha
context.pt: Chelsea, a agradecer aos adeptos que cantaram o seu nome numa fase difícil

text: No no no. I have years of football experience and it is not a couple of victories that put me on the moon and it is not a couple of defeats that send me down to hell.

context.en: Tottenham, asked whether a bright start made them title contenders
context.es: Tottenham, preguntado si el buen inicio los convertía en candidatos al título
context.pt: Tottenham, questionado se o bom arranque os tornava candidatos ao título

text: This is not my home. This is not an easy place to work and be happy.

context.en: Inter, after winning the Serie A title, a week before the Champions League final
context.es: Inter, tras ganar la Serie A, una semana antes de la final de la Champions
context.pt: Inter, depois de ganhar a Serie A, uma semana antes da final da Liga dos Campeões

text: I leave with the conviction that, more than just a moment, we have forged a lasting bond: my player for a day, my player for life.

original.text: Levo comigo a convicção de que, mais do que um momento, criámos uma ligação duradoura: meu jogador um dia, meu jogador para sempre.

context.en: Benfica, in his farewell message to the players
context.es: Benfica, en su mensaje de despedida a los jugadores
context.pt: Benfica, na mensagem de despedida aos jogadores

text: The first half was the coach's fault; the second half was the players' fault.

context.en: Real Madrid, after coming from 3-1 down to win 4-3 at Roma in the Champions League
context.es: Real Madrid, tras remontar un 3-1 y ganar 3-4 en Roma en la Champions
context.pt: Real Madrid, depois de recuperar de 3-1 e vencer por 4-3 em Roma na Liga dos Campeões

text: I trust all the referees... whether it's the league or Champions League, before the game I always have the best feelings about the referees.

context.en: Real Madrid, at his press conference in Rome before the Champions League match
context.es: Real Madrid, en su rueda de prensa en Roma antes del partido de Champions
context.pt: Real Madrid, na conferência de imprensa em Roma antes do jogo da Liga dos Campeões

text: You talk of the title and we talk of time, a project, work. Titles are words, easy promises. Titles will come.

context.en: Roma, at his first press conference
context.es: Roma, en su primera rueda de prensa
context.pt: Roma, na primeira conferência de imprensa

text: I have 25 coins, I throw the coins in the air. The ones that stay on the table are the players that play, the ones that go on the floor, go on the bench. I do it just like this. During the week I'm having fun, I go to nightclubs every day in Istanbul. It's simple.

context.en: Fenerbahçe, a sarcastic reply to a question about his squad rotation
context.es: Fenerbahçe, respuesta sarcástica a una pregunta sobre sus rotaciones
context.pt: Fenerbahçe, resposta sarcástica a uma pergunta sobre as rotações

text: It is my fault: I have won so, so, so much it is hard to live up to those expectations. But the points record in the league is mine and no one can take that away.

context.en: Real Madrid, defending his record near the end of his last season
context.es: Real Madrid, defendiendo su trayectoria al final de su última temporada
context.pt: Real Madrid, a defender o seu registo no fim da última época

text: If we are playing the most important match in the world we have to be happy.

context.en: FC Porto, on the eve of the Champions League final
context.es: FC Porto, en la víspera de la final de la Champions
context.pt: FC Porto, na véspera da final da Liga dos Campeões

text: I really like this squad and looking to the young players – there is not one manager in the world that doesn't like to play young players and to help young players to develop – not one.

context.en: Tottenham, in his first interview after being appointed
context.es: Tottenham, en su primera entrevista tras ser nombrado
context.pt: Tottenham, na primeira entrevista depois de ser nomeado

text: Nobody speaking with fairness and sense can say we don't deserve this title. But the players deserve this more than anybody and I'm very happy for the fans.

context.en: Chelsea, after the win at Bolton that sealed the club's first league title in 50 years
context.es: Chelsea, tras la victoria en Bolton que dio al club su primera liga en 50 años
context.pt: Chelsea, depois da vitória em Bolton que deu ao clube o primeiro campeonato em 50 anos

text: You may as well put a cow in the middle of the pitch. And then stop the game because there was a cow.

context.en: Chelsea, after a defeat at Newcastle, on time-wasting
context.es: Chelsea, tras perder en Newcastle, sobre la pérdida de tiempo
context.pt: Chelsea, depois de perder em Newcastle, sobre o antijogo

text: I'm not going to run away, disappear, cry, because I heard a few boos. I won't disappear from the tunnel running immediately, the next match I'll be first to go out.

context.en: Manchester United, defending his record after a Champions League exit
context.es: Manchester United, defendiendo su trayectoria tras caer en la Champions
context.pt: Manchester United, a defender o seu registo depois da eliminação da Liga dos Campeões

text: Because for me you can only play attacking football when you have the ball. You need the ball. When the opposition has the ball you have to defend.

context.en: Manchester United, asked why his side attacked only when behind
context.es: Manchester United, preguntado por qué su equipo solo atacaba cuando perdía
context.pt: Manchester United, questionado sobre porque a equipa só atacava quando estava a perder

text: I learned we can beat anyone because Chelsea are not just 'anyone', they are one of the best.

context.en: Inter, after knocking his former club Chelsea out of the Champions League at Stamford Bridge
context.es: Inter, tras eliminar a su exequipo, el Chelsea, de la Champions en Stamford Bridge
context.pt: Inter, depois de eliminar o antigo clube, o Chelsea, da Liga dos Campeões em Stamford Bridge

text: This is a giant club without the trophy room in relation to the social dimension of the club. So, this is not a trophy, it's only the final but it means a lot for them.

context.en: Roma, after reaching the club's first European final in 31 years
context.es: Roma, tras alcanzar la primera final europea del club en 31 años
context.pt: Roma, depois de chegar à primeira final europeia do clube em 31 anos

text: There are no words to explain the feeling. We have won all the competitions, of course I am very happy.

context.en: FC Porto, after the Portuguese Cup final that completed a treble
context.es: FC Porto, tras la final de la Copa de Portugal que completó un triplete
context.pt: FC Porto, depois da final da Taça de Portugal que completou um triplete

text: Today the stadium was full – not full of people, full of real support – and it looks like the love that people have for the club is bigger than bad results, bigger than three bad seasons.

context.en: Manchester United, praising the Old Trafford crowd after a League Cup win
context.es: Manchester United, elogiando a la afición de Old Trafford tras ganar en la Copa de la Liga
context.pt: Manchester United, a elogiar os adeptos de Old Trafford depois de uma vitória na Taça da Liga
